The '''Bindreg Hills''' was a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It was located on the foothills of the [[Rhaler's Bastion]] mountain and bordered the [[Riverlands]], near the city of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bindreg Hills is one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" />
